content.short: 1inch aggregates DEX liquidity to optimize cross-chain swaps, routing and pricing across multiple blockchains.
content.description: 1inch aggregates decentralized exchange liquidity across more than 13 chains and provides a native bridge between Solana and EVM networks. Its tools and interfaces empower users and developers to trade, hold, and track digital assets while preserving self-custody. The system focuses on efficient routing, competitive pricing, and robust security to deliver a reliable DeFi experience. 1inch supports an integrated, transparent, and compliant DeFi ecosystem and advocates financial freedom for all.
content.meta: 1inch aggregates DEX liquidity to optimize cross-chain swaps, routing and pricing. Discover 1inch and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: What Is Concentrated Liquidity, and What Does It Fragment?
resources.tldr: Capital efficiency comes at the cost of scattering LP funds across ranges. Clear on both halves, which most explanations of this are not.

resources.title: Shared Liquidity Explained
resources.tldr: One wallet balance backing several positions at once. A different answer to fragmentation than concentration, and worth understanding alongside it.

resources.title: The Clarity Act and Open-Source Developers
resources.tldr: A legal officer arguing for rules rather than against regulation, with specific attention to who is liable for publishing code. Short and unusually direct.
